description: Run one of this server's analysis tools -- analyses a CyberChef operation cannot express, such as recovering an XOR key length, breaking a classical cipher, identifying a hash, validating an X.509 chain or identifying a post-quantum key. List them with cyberchef_categories, get a schema with cyberchef_describe_operation, then run it here. These are NOT operations and cannot be used in a cyberchef_bake recipe.

arguments.description: Arguments for the tool, matching the schema cyberchef_describe_operation returns for it.

tool.description: Analysis tool name, without the `cyberchef_` prefix, e.g. "hash_identify", "xor_key_length", "pqc_identify". Either form is accepted.

name: cyberchef_analyse
